answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 32912 Country: India Title: From the past few years I have been staying away from my native place. We always try for seeking a transfer but there's no way we can have a transfer. Question: From the past few years I have been staying away from my native place. We always try for seeking a transfer but there's no way we can have a transfer. so I kindly request you to tell of some dua in this respect. P.S. As asked by you to surf and find out whether this sort of question has already been answered, I have found one with your answer regarding supplicating Allah with salatul hajat. I want to know some more duas I can add to this. Answer ID: 32912 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1072/901/B=1432) Keep on recitingحسبنا الله و نعم الوكيل extensively. Also, reciteلا حول ولا قوة الا بالله five hundred times daily for forty days along with durood 100 times, and then supplicate to Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
